scope: Private local Newcomb/Frobenius coefficient and discriminant control using production surface stiffness and mass, before first native measurement. No global spectrum, finite-m stability, physical-mass pole mode, import qualification, or finite total negative-count claim. Root will rebuild current source before promotion.

acceptance.controls: positive discriminant forC=-9/5,negative forC=-1; critical only within unchanged absolute budget

premasurement_budget_justification.exact_stencils: Independent 80-digit mpmath evaluation of analytical a,b,c before native measurements. Worst alpha relative Richardson truncation2.439e-5,beta scaledabs2.782e-5,Deltaabs8.089e-5; coarse/mid ratios4.03..4.17. Chosen budgets allow truncation with margin.
premasurement_budget_justification.condition: For all frozen points r in[15/16,17/16], Bz² in[0.76,1.22], B²<2.35,K² in[7,9],mu0*gamma*p in[0.02,0.32],F²>0.0008. Physical tangential trace<24,det=K²*mu0*gamma*p*F²>0.000112,so kappa2<trace²/det<5.15e6; cap1e8 leaves arithmetic margin. No floor/shift permitted.

execution_policy: Native CMake/CTest,Release gfortran,O3,Wall,Wextra,Werror=array-temporaries,fcheck=all,build-j2,OMP/BLAS1. Stop on full raw Bernstein mismatch. Preserve failures and frozen settings; no postmeasurement budget tuning.
